text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.31, which is below the hiring threshold. The strongest evidence for the Java Software Engineer role is their experience with API development, as they "Built REST APIs" and demonstrated proficiency in Spring Boot. Key gaps include a lack of required experience in ci/cd and monitoring, as well as missing nice-to-have skills in api gateway and containerisation. Despite these missing requirements, the application has been escalated for further review.
